text:
Augustus III most likely bought Correggio's *The Holy Night* (*Adoration of the Shepherds*) in 1746. It was a large altarpiece, and it came to Dresden in the Modena purchase of that year. That same purchase also included other Correggio works, such as the *Madonna of Saint George*, so my earlier answer wasn't exactly wrong. I'm going from memory and the team note, not a checked source.

CONFIDENCE: 60
